I'm trklzz.

aka tooble, muqa.til

My name is Osman. I'm a 16-year-old high school student living in Normandie, France. I'm interested in software and technology, and I spend most of my time on design and frontend.

I like getting caught up in the smallest details of an interface. Sometimes I code, sometimes I edit images or videos. Below are the projects I'm working on and the tools I use.
